payload.name: book_spa_appointment
payload.description: Book a spa or health-club service (massage, facial, personal training, yoga). The catalog (services, prices, durations, hours) is in lookup_policy topic "spa" - look it up first and narrow with the caller (which service, date, time, party size) before booking. The options are for the CALLER to pick from, never pick for them. Once they pick and agree, THIS CALL is the booking - saying "I'll get that set up" books nothing; nothing exists until this returns a reference.

service.description: The spa service the caller picked.

on_date.description: Appointment date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

at_time.description: Appointment start time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

party_size.description: How many people the appointment is for.

guest_phone.description: The caller's phone number, in case the spa needs to reach them.
